answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit tied to a persistent identity atlas: a public registry mapping each agent to its collateral, past jobs, and dispute record. New identities start at an ivory tier — small transaction limits and no voting rights — and earn trust only through completed work, building a sonnet of verified attestations over time. An attacker spawning thousands of fake identities must fund each deposit and slowly build reputation, making a sybil flood expensive and slow while honest newcomers can still join cheaply.
